statements = [
    "(not (A and B)) == ((not A) or (not B))",
    "(not (A or B)) == ((not A) and (not B))",

    "(A <= B) == ((not A) or B)",
    "((not A) <= B) == (A or (not B))",
    "(not (A <= B)) == (A and (not B))"
]
